label: ADAPTIVE (motivated by observed D / R witness values); registered before the P70 / P70A fits; no method claim
diagnostic: A1_PO_16 recipe refitted on the whole non-panel pool (P70: 14,022 people, 70% of MODEL_FIT; FIT-only dictionary) and the same rows / folds with the admitted dictionary (P70A); each witness evaluated on MODEL_SELECT against both seeds' references (H3 income)
yardstick: fit-to-fit spread at a fixed size, from the paired MODEL_SELECT differences D1 - D0 and R1 - R0 (reference-free); 'near' means within that spread

reading_rule.near_log_linear: consistent with a size effect being sufficient; cannot exclude a fit-specific selection component at 100%
reading_rule.near_53_values: the 100% advantage is not explained by a smooth size effect over 42-70%; consistent with fit-specific selection, a step-like size effect between 70% and 100% (e.g. dictionary collapse), or other source-fit differences; cannot distinguish among them
reading_rule.at_or_beyond_source: selection is not needed to explain the source margin at 70% or more; the 42-53% shortfall is a training-size effect of the partition design
reading_rule.P70A_minus_P70: separates the FIT-only dictionary collapse from training size at fixed rows

may_not: a population learning curve or causal attribution to size
that selection explains or does not explain the source margin (only consistent with)
that a 100% refit would restore the reserve
any change to rules, partitions or the NO_RECIPE outcome
kept_out_of_selection: no P70 / P70A output becomes a witness, baseline slack, recipe or rule input; no rerun of the D or R stages is triggered
counting: two fitted release specifications (P70, P70A); evaluation against both seeds is one evaluation per seed of the same fit
